units.source_text: 我终于和叔叔开始了谈判。

en.t: At last I began negotiations with my uncle.

units.source_text: 使用‘谈判’这个词也许不大妥当，但是从事情的发展来说，已经到了只有用这个词形容才自然的地步。

en.t: The word negotiations may perhaps be somewhat inappropriate, but given the way matters had developed, it had reached a point where no other word seemed natural.

units.source_text: 叔叔总想把我当个孩子来糊弄，而我则是带着猜疑的眼光坐在谈判桌前的，因而，不可能平和地加以解决。

en.t: My uncle kept trying to treat me like a child and put me off, while I sat at the negotiating table with suspicious eyes, so there was no possibility of resolving it peacefully.

units.source_text: 很遗憾，我现在急于往下交代，以至于无法把那次谈判的详细始末写在这里。

en.t: Unfortunately, I am now so eager to move on with my account that I cannot write the full details of those negotiations here.

units.source_text: 说实在的，还有比这重要的事情等着我去写，我的笔尖跃跃欲试，想尽快奔向那里，我好容易才控制住它。

en.t: To tell the truth, there are matters more important than this waiting for me to write about, and my pen is straining to hurry there as quickly as possible; I can barely hold it back.

units.source_text: 永远失去了对你从容讲述的机会的我，不仅不习惯写字，而且从珍惜时间的意义上说，也必须略去一些想说的内容。

en.t: Having forever lost the chance to speak to you calmly in person, I am not only unaccustomed to writing, but also, in the interest of valuing time, must leave out some of the things I want to say.
